description: Abstract class representing a custom shipping quote item with pricing details, including methods to set and get the price and its textual representation.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuoteItem
classes.description: An abstract class encapsulating shipping quote item details such as price and price text.

methods.name: setPriceText
methods.description: Sets the textual representation of the shipping quote's price.

methods.name: getPriceText
methods.description: Retrieves the textual representation of the shipping quote's price.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the actual numeric price of the shipping quote.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the numeric price of the shipping quote.
